item.title: Musk blames India’s oligarchs, New Delhi cites security and the villages keep waiting
item.description: Late on October 7, Elon Musk complained on X that “certain oligarchs” were keeping Starlink out of India, and the next day he asked, by name , whether Mukesh Ambani really runs the country. India’s communications ministry answered that all three licensed satellite operators sit at the same stage of review, that security checks are still under way for all of them, and it called the charge “baseless and misconceived.”

item.title: UK awards ClearSpace $80 million prime contract for dual-satellite deorbit mission
item.description: The UK Space Agency has picked Luxembourg-headquartered ClearSpace’s British unit as prime contractor for a 2029 mission aiming to de-orbit two defunct small satellites, the in-orbit servicing venture announced Oct. 15.

item.title: Rocket Lab delays first Neutron launch again
item.description: Rocket Lab announced Oct. 14 that the first launch of its Neutron rocket has been delayed again, to sometime in 2027, citing issues producing carbon composite components for the vehicle.
